content:
alex.chen: taking over primary for the next 12h. quick transfer note — please read before closing the handoff. i'm primary, @morgan is secondary. coverage gap flagged for APAC late window (01:00-03:00 UTC) — if anyone can jump into a partial overlap pls shout now.

morgan: ack. i'll validate PD + grafana + aws assume role now.

incident-bot: [ALERT] prod-api error-rate spike (503) triggered monitor: prod.api.rolling-error-rate. PagerDuty escalation sent to 'Prod API - Page'.

sara.g: if we get a page, follow the runbook first: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/prod-api/503 — steps: confirm impact, identify recent deploys, check downstream queues. key dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/prod-api/prod-api-health and request traces at https://traces.redwood.com/search?service=prod-api.

alex.chen: quick access checklist for whoever is taking primary (copy/verify):
- PagerDuty
  - open https://secure.pagerduty.com/services/P12345 and ensure escalation policy = "Prod API - Page"
  - confirm your user has "Respond" permissions on the service and 2FA is active
- AWS
  - assume the oncall role (STS):
```
  aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Oncall_Admin --role-session-name oncall_transfer
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=...
  aws sts get-caller-identity
```
  - verify you can read CloudWatch logs and describe EC2/Lambdas. Write access is intentionally restricted; if you need SecretsManager:GetSecretValue or KMS decrypt, open a ticket with security and @oncall-lead. Temporary role TTL is 1h by default.
- Grafana
  - SSO must map to org role "OncallViewer". check dashboard above and ensure panels load (not just cached). If panels 401 -> re-login via SSO, otherwise raise idp@redwood.com.
- Misc
  - session-manager available for SSH-less access: `aws ssm start-session --target i-abcdef123`
  - helper script for logs: `./scripts/logs -s prod-api --tail 200` (requires assume-role)
  - runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/prod-api/503

morgan: done — PagerDuty ok (Respond), Grafana dashboards load, able to assume role, `aws sts get-caller-identity` returned expected account. quick note: SecretsManager:GetSecretValue not allowed for me so i can't fetch service token X. i made a request ticket: SEC-1734. :white_check_mark:

jerome: leaving a couple of tips from yesterday's bridge:
- if PD pages but the dashboard is flapping, check the traffic splice job in ecs-prod (svc traffic-splicer) — common transient cause.
- for urgent KMS decrypt (eg to validate a signing key), contact @oncall-lead directly with reason and timeframe.
- if SSO is down and you need console access, there's a fallback emergency role via identity team (requires phone approval).

alex.chen: operational runbook additions i added during last rotation:
- Short commands for quick checks included above.
- Contact fallback: primary phone + DM @oncall-lead (use for PD/SSO blocker only).
- If PagerDuty fails to trigger pages, call the oncall rota number: +1-555-0112 and update the incident channel.

incident-bot: [INFO] alert auto-mitigation attempted: prefix-caching rollbacks triggered on prod-api (ID: 0x9a7) — see action log: https://ops.redwood.com/actions/0x9a7

morgan: i see the auto-mitigation, dashboards trending down. i'll stay secondary and monitor for 30m post-handoff.

alex.chen: leaving handoff note pinned to this thread. final status: PD ok, AWS assume-role ok (no secret fetch), Grafana ok, runbook reachable, APAC coverage gap noted. i'm officially primary now. if anything blocks access during my shift i'll comment here and page the next available oncall. :rocket:

sara.g: thanks — leaving a quick checklist for anyone taking over later: verify PD Respond perms, confirm STS assume-role works and TTL set >= 30m, confirm Grafana panels show current windows (not static snapshots). document any discrepancies in the runbook comments.

alex.chen: thanks all. starting monitoring window.

oncall-lead: noted coverage gap for APAC. i'll try to cover the 01:00-02:00 UTC slot. if you need me to join bridge DM me.
